issues.title: BLU-021 Synthetic benchmark harness - fake-clock traces and reproducible precision/recall and performance metrics

criteria.requirement: Synthetic benchmark deterministic: fake-clock traces and reproducible precision/recall and latency

tests.name: seeded fake clock yields identical traces precision recall and latency

criteria.requirement: Success, invalid input, offline, timeout, denied permission, cancellation and restart paths tested where applicable
criteria.reason: New test 'invalid input timeout and cancellation have explicit outcomes' proves only the listed paths on the synchronous local seam. Denied permission and restart lifecycle are not wired or evidenced, so the complete criterion remains a gap.

criteria.requirement: No unintended cloud egress, secret storage, unsafe automatic action or silent downgrade
criteria.reason: New test 'offline in-memory seam performs no egress persistence or automatic action' runs a pure in-memory index only; it cannot establish app-wide egress, secret storage, or downgrade safety.

criteria.requirement: User-facing states are accessible, RTL-compatible and reversible where applicable
criteria.reason: This headless benchmark has no new user-facing screens. UI accessibility and RTL require product-owner applicability review.
